metadata.name: garhwali
metadata.description: Standard Python library for Garhwali language processing, morphology, universal translation, linguistics, and Himalayan oral culture.

quickstart.code:
import garhwali
# 1. Translation result = garhwali.translate("Where are you going?", source="en", dialect="srinagariya") print(result.text) # 'तुमु कख जाणा छा?' print(result.romanized) # 'Tumu kakh jaana chha?'
# 2. Voice Translation & Speech Synthesis v_res = garhwali.voice_translate("Hello, how are you?", generate_audio=True) print(v_res.translated_text) # 'तुमु कना छा?' print(v_res.syllables) # ['तु', 'मु', 'क', 'ना', 'छा'] print(v_res.ssml) # Speech synthesis markup
# 3. Dictionary & 2.39M+ Inflections Engine word = garhwali.lookup("डांडा") print(word.english) # 'mountain ridge / summit ridge' print(garhwali.pluralize("डांडा")) # 'डांडा'
# 4. Verb Conjugation conj = garhwali.conjugate("खाणु", tense=garhwali.Tense.PRESENT, person=3, gender=garhwali.Gender.MASCULINE) print(conj) # 'खान्दू' / 'खाद च'
# 5. Numbers & Fractions print(garhwali.num_to_words(25)) # 'बीस पाँच' print(garhwali.fraction("डेढ़")) # 1.5 print(garhwali.words_to_num("पच्चीस")) # 25
# 6. Classical Holi Songs & Folklore holi_songs = garhwali.FolkloreTreasury.list_holi_songs() print(f"Loaded {len(holi_songs)} classical Baithki & Khadi Holi compositions")
# 7. Digitized Historical Books (86 books, 23,856 pages) books = garhwali.list_digital_books() page = garhwali.read_book_page(books[0]['id'], page_number=1) print(page.text[:100])
